Next Generation Guard Passing by Mica Ga.overview: Mica Galvão's gi passing course in three parts (about 1h 45m). Part 1 covers the knee cut, his main passing weapon. Part 2 covers submissions while passing (including the baseball bat choke). Part 3 covers the toreando and over-under passes.
Next Generation Guard Passing by Mica Ga.for: Gi passers who want a fast, modern passing game.
key: Baseball bat choke and other submissions while passing

NoGi Closed Guard by Ffion Davies.overview: Ffion Davies' no-gi closed guard, four parts. Part 1 covers closed guard maintenance and control. Part 2 covers the omoplata (into a short choke and into the Nicolini armbar). Part 3 covers the shoulder crunch and its set-ups. Part 4 covers the hip bump sweep and hip bump kimura.
key: Omoplata to short choke and Nicolini armbar

OPEN GUARD GI FUNDAMENTALS GO FURTHER.overview: John Danaher's gi open guard fundamentals, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers open guard theory. Volume 2 covers balancing offence and defence and the two crucial skill sets. Volume 3 covers attacking an opponent on two knees. Volume 4 covers sumi gaeshi with chest contact and the hook sweep from supine. Volume 5 covers attacking an opponent on one knee (the knee drop). Volume 6 is a special study of the cross collar and sleeve / bicep guard ('the single greatest open guard'). Volume 7 covers ashi garami sweeps. Volume 8 is a special study of the double kouchi gari.
OPEN GUARD GI FUNDAMENTALS GO FURTHER.for: Gi open guard players at any level.

Passing the Guard Gi Fundamentals Go Fur.overview: John Danaher's gi guard passing fundamentals, eight volumes built around a five-step passing system. It covers posture and opening the closed guard, getting past the legs with both mobility passes (the toreando and its variations) and pressure passes (knee cut, stack and over-under), and consolidating the pass into a pin. The publisher listing has no per-volume breakdown.

Roger Gracie - Roger Gracie Mount System.overview: Roger Gracie's famous gi mount, three parts. Part 1 covers the concepts behind his mount. Part 2 covers moving from a flat mount to a sitting-up mount and reaching high mount. Part 3 covers the submissions, especially the cross collar choke and the armlock from mount, and how they combine.
Roger Gracie - Roger Gracie Mount System.for: Gi players who want a simple, high-percentage mount.

Roger Gracie - The Guard System Bundle/C.overview: Roger Gracie's gi closed guard, four parts (a lower-quality copy is also in your library). Part 1 introduces the closed guard. Part 2 covers armlocks. Part 3 covers 'lumberjack' attacks (the lumberjack sweep against a standing opponent and its follow-ups). Part 4 covers back attacks (taking the back from closed guard).

Roger Gracie - The Guard System Bundle/H.overview: Roger Gracie's gi bottom half guard, three parts. Part 1 covers getting from bottom to top with half guard sweeps. Part 2 covers the kimura and sweep from bottom half guard, and the kneebar. Part 3 covers taking the back from bottom half guard and replacing guard against the inverted half guard.
